comments.author: Vegetable_Voice_2044
comments.body:
It takes a full day or two with constant interaction with Gemini pro hitting the limit multiple times a day, to get a prototype of a feature developed for my project. And that's just for pure code, no time wasted on art stuff.

So 10 prompts is too few for any advanced system for a project.

For example. I wanted enemy in my game to detect the player, ai gave it. I wanted it to be better then what j initially asked for. Ai did it, I wanted it better with another idea plugged in, ai did it.
Rinse, repeat, rinse, repeat. By end of day my brain is fried, and I have a prototype that I will finish the last steps of making the most recently added feature functional.

Suprisngly refactoring a dozen scripts to redisign these systems is much faster than designing them j. The first place.
